title: World Pulse
tagline: Live conflict tracker, AI world brief, and global deals & crises — free app and public API.

ai._comment: Claude-powered analysis, run once per build in CI (never per reader). Needs the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY repository secret; without it the build uses rule-based analysis and costs nothing. Cost scales with model choice: see README → AI.
ai._translate_comment: Languages the AI brief and conflict summaries are translated into after each new brief (one short call per language, counted against budget_usd): de German, sr Serbian Cyrillic. [] turns translations off.
ai._budget_comment: Hard cap on total AI spend in US dollars, counted across all builds (see api/v1/ai-usage.json). When it is reached the build switches to rule-based analysis until you raise it. Set to null for no cap.

pro._comment: World Pulse Pro (docs/PRO.md). api_url is the license server; the Deploy Pro workflow writes it. Empty keeps Pro dormant: no bundle, and the app shows 'Pro is launching soon' instead of buy buttons. sender_email is the verified Brevo sender of the license emails.

revenue._comment: Every revenue field is optional; empty values are not shown. The repository Variables KOFI_PAGE, NEWSLETTER_URL, CONTACT_EMAIL and TIKTOK_HANDLE override these without editing this file (README → Revenue).

plans.name: World Pulse Pro
plans.blurb: The analyst's view of every conflict, every morning: what changed, why it matters and what to watch next.
features: Daily Pro Intelligence Briefing: top 5 hotspots with key actors, risk outlook and a 72-hour watch list
90-day trends for every theater: peaks, 30-day series and changes
Instant breaking alerts when a conflict turns critical or escalates
Personal watchlist, CSV/JSON export and no support prompts
Your own license key by email, works on web, Android and iPhone

plans.name: Business
plans.blurb: World Pulse Pro for your team: for newsrooms, NGOs, researchers and apps that build on the API.
features: Everything in Pro, for your team
Priority email support and integration help
Request new sources and conflict theaters
